$comment: DISCLAIMER: This reference data is for informational purposes only. It does NOT constitute legal or tax advice. It declares TERRITORIAL containment between jurisdiction tokens and the per-axis resolution order over it. It never adjudicates legal precedence between extensions - see docs/implement/extension-composition.md.
description: Declared jurisdiction containment and per-axis resolution. The standard keys succession law and death taxation at different granularities; this file declares how a consumer crosses that gap, or refuses. A null resolvesTo ALWAYS carries a reason: a declared refusal and an unfilled hole must never look the same. Enforced by scripts/check-jurisdiction-cascade.py.

succession.description: Succession law. Resolution up a containment edge is OFF by default: there is no UK-wide, EU-wide or US-federal succession law to resolve to.

tax.description: Death and inheritance taxation. Resolution up a containment edge is permitted only where an edge declares it.

succession.reason: The United Kingdom is not one succession jurisdiction and ships no succession profile row. Resolve by domicile to GB-EAW (or its GB-ENG key), GB-SCT or GB-NIR; there is nothing to resolve UPWARD to.

tax.reason: GB is itself the fiscal territory for inheritance tax; it carries the tax rows.

succession.reason: GB-EAW IS the succession jurisdiction (one jurisdiction spanning England and Wales, Senior Courts Act 1981 s.61); its constituents have no separate succession law to resolve to.

tax.reason: Inheritance tax is a single fiscal territory across the whole United Kingdom (IHTA 1984); the UK's separate succession jurisdictions share one death-tax regime, so a UK subdivision key resolves to the GB tax rows.
tax.authority: Inheritance Tax Act 1984 ss.1-6 — a single charge to inheritance tax across the whole United Kingdom

succession.reason: US succession law is a state matter; the US profile row carries the federal layer and the common features, not a law that states inherit from.

tax.reason: The US tax rows carry the FEDERAL estate tax only. State-level estate and inheritance taxes are declared by state extensions and are never resolved from this row.

succession.reason: US succession law is a state matter; there is no federal succession law to resolve to.

tax.reason: REFUSAL, not absence. US states levy their own estate and inheritance taxes alongside the federal estate tax, so resolving a state key up to the federal US rows would silently assert that the federal figures are the whole answer. cf. 72 P.S. s.9116 (Pennsylvania inheritance tax). A state's death-tax position must be declared, not inherited.
